{{Quote|Your Passport to Adventure|''Galaxy Tours'' slogan|<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>}}
'''Galaxy Tours''' was a major starline which operated from before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] through the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Galaxy Tours subsidiaries owned a number of the most profitable resorts in the galaxy, including the well-known [[Nara Parks]] and [[Towers of Pantolomin]]. The travel firm also offered a wide variety of [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] vacation packages for both businesses and individuals and was a [[contributing sponsor]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

==History==
A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the start of the Clone Wars in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of the company was [[Bronwynn Koft]]. That year, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] approved a surtax on passengers traveling via registered starliners such as Galaxy Tours, a decision against which Koft complained.<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_3.html|Senate Approves Transit Tax}}</ref> Some time later, the [[transit tax]] made it difficult for refugees to reach the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], at the expense of Galaxy Tours.<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}</ref>

Two of the Galaxy Tours cruisers, on [[Yuga 2]] and in the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]], were raided by pirate [[Callow Batta]] between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

Sometime during the Galactic Civil War, prior to the Rebel Alliance retaking Coruscant, Galaxy Tours had the [[Grand Galactic Tour]], which involved the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] stopping at, in order of the weeks, Tatooine, Endor, Bespin, and [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]].<ref name="RPG" />
